text: The pipeline and its infrastructure only get checked today if someone remembers to test them by hand. This lesson wires both into GitHub itself.
The Glue ETL's dedup logic moves into a plain, AWS-free module so pytest can run it against a local Spark session. Terraform gets fmt, validate, and plan -- never apply -- in the same pull request.
A test feeds the transform two copies of the same reading and asserts exactly one survives -- the same dedup logic Lesson 16 later finds a real gap in.
Terraform plan runs with a read-only, plan-only role. It can show a reviewer exactly what a change would do to the Kinesis stream or the Redshift cluster -- it can never actually do it.
Both checks are now required before anything merges. Next: watching the pipeline while it actually runs.
